description: Side-profile (right-facing) wing-flap flight loop used as the swooping 용 그림자 in the Dragon Wing (용의 날개) active skill. Mirrored horizontally at runtime for leftward flight. Separate from the rear-view companion sortie sheet (red_dragon_companion_wing_flap.png) — do not conflate the two.

source_autosprite.character_base_prompt: Chibi super-deformed baby red dragon mascot, strict SIDE PROFILE view facing right, hovering in flight. Bright warm red scales, cream-tan belly, two curved golden horns, large amber eye, cyan-teal gem accents (forehead, neck collar, belly concentric circle, knee/wing rings), red bat wings, long spade-tip tail.
source_autosprite.animation_prompt: strict side profile facing right, hovering in place while flying, flapping both red bat wings strongly up and down in a smooth seamless loop, long tail sways gently, body stays centered and level, continuous forward flight pose

postprocess.operation: Convert AutoSprite palette(P) sheet to RGBA, save verbatim grid (no re-layout). Corners verified transparent; last (25th) cell is empty by design (24 frames in a 5x5 grid).

runtime_wiring.constants: DRAGON_SHEET_PATH / DRAGON_SHEET_COLS=5 / DRAGON_SHEET_ROWS=5 / DRAGON_SHEET_FRAME_COUNT=24 / DRAGON_FLAP_FPS=22 / DRAGON_SPRITE_DRAW_SIZE=160
runtime_wiring.flip_rule: dir<0 (leftward flight) -> _blit_flipped_region; dir>0 -> draw_texture_rect_region (source faces right)
runtime_wiring.blend: colored sprite drawn with default mix blend (canvas.material=null), fiery glow/aura accents drawn additive around it

status: Accepted and wired as the Dragon Wing skill's side-profile flying dragon shadow (replaces the prior rear-view companion sheet reuse).
